Faq.title: Questions before you book
Faq.subtitle: The most common questions you may need answered before booking
Faq.q1: What documents do I need to rent a car?
Faq.a1: A national ID or passport, and a valid driving license. Contact us to confirm the required documents for your booking.
Faq.q2: Can I rent a car with a driver?
Faq.a2: Yes, you can add a private driver while booking, or rent without a driver depending on the available car.
Faq.a3: You pay online after choosing the service, dates and extras, in Egyptian pounds or US dollars depending on the currency you pick.
Faq.q4: Can I change or cancel my booking?
Faq.a4: Message us on WhatsApp any time and we will explain the change or cancellation terms for your booking.
Faq.a5: Yes, you can add «Airport pickup» as an extra while booking, and our driver will be waiting for you in the arrivals hall.
Faq.q6: What are the check-in and check-out times for hotel apartments?
Faq.a6: Times vary by apartment and are shown on each apartment's details page before you book.
Faq.q7: Is the displayed price the final price?
Faq.a7: The displayed price is per day or per night. Extras and discounts appear in the booking summary before payment, so you know the final total before you pay.
Faq.q8: What if my dates are not available?
Faq.a8: Booked dates appear closed in the calendar. If you need different dates or another car, contact us and we will help.
Faq.stillAsking: Still have a question? Contact us and we will reply quickly

Reviews.title: What our customers say
Reviews.subtitle: Real experiences from people who tried our services.
Reviews.r1: I landed at 3 AM completely exhausted, and the driver was already waiting with my name and a bottle of water. The trip started right from the very first minute. Thank you to the whole team for the care and effort 🤍
Reviews.r2: I booked the car in minutes from my phone and paid online with zero hassle. It arrived spotless and smelling great, and the driver was so polite. Truly top-level service.
Reviews.r3: The apartment was even better than the photos! Clean, tidy and had everything I needed. It felt like a hotel, not just an apartment. Thank you Solo Limo team, I will definitely be back.
Reviews.r4: I was nervous about booking online for the first time, but the team walked me through every step on WhatsApp and replied right away. Such kind and patient service, wishing you all the best.
Reviews.r5: We arrived with my family, lots of bags and a small child, and the team thought of everything, even the child seat was ready. First time I traveled this relaxed. Thank you for the attention to detail.
Reviews.r6: Prices were clear from the start with no surprises at payment, and the timing was perfect to the minute. People who respect your time and your money. Sincere thanks to everyone I worked with.

AboutPage.title: Your journey starts with <g>Solo Limo</g>
AboutPage.intro: We bring together everything you need for your trip in one place: airport pickup, luxury cars and fully equipped hotel apartments, with refined service and clear prices.
AboutPage.storyTitle: A simple idea: a trip without the hassle
AboutPage.story1: Solo Limo started from a simple idea: a traveler should arrive and relax, without searching for a car in one place, an apartment in another and a driver somewhere else.
AboutPage.story2: That is why we brought three services together: you book the car, choose the apartment, and learn the airport procedures step by step, all from one website with online payment.
AboutPage.story3: And we care about the small details that make a difference, from a spotless car, to punctual timing, to a quick reply to your questions.
AboutPage.quote: We take you there comfortably, and welcome you with respect.
AboutPage.missionText: To provide a comfortable and reliable travel and stay experience, with respectful service and clear prices, so every customer starts their trip easily and ends it satisfied.
AboutPage.visionText: To be the first choice for every traveler looking for comfort, luxury and trust, from the moment of arrival until the moment of departure.
AboutPage.offerSubtitle: Three core services that cover your trip from start to finish.
AboutPage.airportText: Our driver waits for you in the arrivals hall, with a simple guide explaining the arrival and departure steps.
AboutPage.carsText: A fleet of luxury and family cars, with or without a driver, for the duration that suits you.
AboutPage.apartmentsText: Fully equipped apartments with hotel service, suitable for short and long stays.
AboutPage.why1Text: Your time matters, and we respect every agreed appointment from the first moment.

AboutPage.why4Text: Our team is available on WhatsApp for any question before booking or during your trip.
AboutPage.why5Text: You see the final total with extras and discount before you pay, with no surprises.
AboutPage.why6Text: Committed and respectful drivers who care about your comfort and safety.

FaqPage.title: Everything you need to know <g>before you book</g>
FaqPage.intro: We gathered the most common questions and simple articles to help you book with confidence and prepare for your trip without having to ask.
FaqPage.noResultsTitle: No results found for your search
FaqPage.noResultsText: Try another word, or message us on WhatsApp and we will answer you directly.
FaqPage.a1: Choose the service (a car or a hotel apartment), pick the dates, add what you need, review the final price, then pay online. As soon as the payment succeeds, the booking is confirmed.
FaqPage.q2: Do I need an account to book?
FaqPage.a2: Yes, you create an account once and your details are saved. From your account you follow your bookings and find your customer code.
FaqPage.q3: Can I change or cancel my booking?
FaqPage.a3: Message us on WhatsApp any time and we will explain the change or cancellation terms for your booking.
FaqPage.q4: What if my dates are not available?
FaqPage.a4: Booked dates appear closed. If you need different dates or another car or apartment, contact us and we will help you find a suitable alternative.
FaqPage.a5: You pay online on the website through a secure payment gateway, after choosing everything and reviewing the final summary.
FaqPage.q6: Can I pay in US dollars?
FaqPage.a6: Yes, you can switch the currency at the top of the page between Egyptian pounds and US dollars, and prices are shown in the currency you choose.
FaqPage.q7: How does the discount code work?
FaqPage.a7: You enter the code on the payment page and the discount is applied automatically before the final total. After your first booking, you can contact us with your customer code and we will give you a discount code for next time.
FaqPage.a8: The booking is confirmed after a successful payment. If it is not paid, it is automatically cancelled after about 30 minutes so the dates become available again.
FaqPage.q9: What documents do I need to rent a car?
FaqPage.a9: A national ID or passport, and a valid driving license. Contact us to confirm the documents for your booking type.
FaqPage.q10: Can I rent a car with a driver?
FaqPage.a10: Yes, you can add a private driver while booking, or rent without a driver depending on the available car.
FaqPage.q11: Is the displayed price the final price?
FaqPage.a11: The displayed price is per day. Extras and discounts appear in the booking summary before payment, so you know the final total before you pay.
FaqPage.q12: What are the check-in and check-out times for apartments?
FaqPage.a12: Times vary by apartment and are shown on each apartment's details page before you book.
FaqPage.q13: Can I book an apartment for more than one night?
FaqPage.a13: Of course. You choose the check-in and check-out dates, and the total is calculated by the number of nights.
FaqPage.q14: What is included in the apartment?
FaqPage.a14: The facilities and services of each apartment are listed on its details page, and you can ask us on WhatsApp about any detail.
FaqPage.a15: Yes, you can add «Airport pickup» as an extra while booking, and our driver will be waiting for you in the arrivals hall.
FaqPage.q16: What if my flight is delayed?
FaqPage.a16: Send us your flight details on WhatsApp before arrival, so we can coordinate with you and be ready at the new time.
FaqPage.articlesTitle: Simple guides that help before you book
FaqPage.articlesSubtitle: Short and clear articles answering the questions travelers ask most.
FaqPage.art1Title: Airport arrival procedures, step by step
FaqPage.art1Excerpt: From the moment you land until you get into the car, this is the order you will go through.
FaqPage.art1P1: The first step after leaving the plane is heading to passport control. Prepare your passport and any documents required for entry, and check the entry requirements for your nationality with the official authority before you travel.
FaqPage.art1P2: After your passport is stamped, you go to the baggage belts and collect your bags. If your bag is delayed or damaged, report it to the airport baggage office before you leave.
FaqPage.art1P3: Then comes customs. Know the prohibited and allowed items in advance to save time and avoid any problems.
FaqPage.art1P4: Finally you exit to the arrivals hall, and if you booked pickup with us you will find our driver waiting. Send us your flight details on WhatsApp before arrival so we can follow its schedule.
FaqPage.art2Title: How to choose the right car for your trip
FaqPage.art2Excerpt: The number of people, the bags and the type of trip decide the best car.
FaqPage.art2P1: Start with the number of people and amount of luggage. For a large family or many bags, a van is more comfortable and cheaper than two cars.
FaqPage.art2P2: Think about the type of trip: for formal trips or events, a luxury car with a driver makes a great impression, and for daily travel, an economical family car is enough.
FaqPage.art2P3: Decide whether you need a driver. With a driver you focus on your trip and skip traffic and parking, and without one you control your own schedule.
FaqPage.art2P4: Prepare your ID or passport and a valid driving license, and review the final summary with the price and extras before paying.
FaqPage.art3Title: What to check before booking a hotel apartment
FaqPage.art3Excerpt: Simple points that guarantee a comfortable stay from the first night.
FaqPage.art3P1: Decide the number of guests and rooms you need, and make sure the apartment suits you in terms of space and capacity.
FaqPage.art3P2: Read the apartment details carefully: the available facilities, the location, the check-in and check-out times, and look at the photos closely.
FaqPage.art3P3: Compare the price by the number of nights, and remember the total is calculated per night plus any services you choose.
FaqPage.art3P4: If you have a special request or a question about a specific detail, message us on WhatsApp before booking so you feel reassured.
FaqPage.art4Title: How to benefit from the discount code
FaqPage.art4Excerpt: A simple way to save on your upcoming bookings.
FaqPage.art4P1: After you create your account and book, your customer code appears inside your account.
FaqPage.art4P2: Contact us on WhatsApp and send your customer code, and we will send you a discount code to use on your next booking.
FaqPage.art4P3: On the payment page, enter the discount code and it is applied automatically before the final total.
FaqPage.art4P4: Review the summary before paying, and make sure the discount appears and that the code is still valid and has not expired.
FaqPage.ctaText: Our team is ready to reply quickly on WhatsApp and help you choose what suits you best.

PrivacyPage.title: Your privacy <g>matters to us</g>
PrivacyPage.intro: This policy explains what data we collect when you use the Solo Limo website, and how we use and protect it.
PrivacyPage.s1Text: We only collect the information needed to provide our services and complete your booking, including:
PrivacyPage.s1B1: Account details: name, phone number and email.
PrivacyPage.s1B2: Booking details: service type, dates, extras and total.
PrivacyPage.s1B3: Information you send us via WhatsApp or the contact form.
PrivacyPage.s1B4: Basic website usage data to improve performance.
PrivacyPage.s2Text: We use your data for the following purposes only:
PrivacyPage.s2B2: Contacting you about your booking or inquiry.
PrivacyPage.s2B3: Issuing your customer code and applying discount codes.
PrivacyPage.s2B4: Improving the website and the quality of our services.
PrivacyPage.s3Text: Payments are processed through a secure external payment gateway. We do not store your bank card details on our servers, and we only receive the result of the transaction (success or failure) and its reference number to confirm the booking.
PrivacyPage.s4Text: We use a limited number of files that are necessary to run the website:
PrivacyPage.s4B2: Currency preference (local storage in your browser).
PrivacyPage.s4B3: The login session to keep you signed in while using the website.
PrivacyPage.s5Text: We do not sell your data to anyone. We may share it only with service providers necessary to run the website, such as the payment gateway, database provider and hosting, or when there is a legal obligation.
PrivacyPage.s6Text: We apply technical and organizational measures to protect your data, including restricting access so that each customer only sees their own data and bookings. However, no method of electronic transmission or storage is 100% secure.
PrivacyPage.s7Text: You have the right to request access to your data, correct it, or delete your account at any time by contacting us.
PrivacyPage.s8Text: We keep your data for as long as you use your account, and as needed for accounting and legal obligations, then we delete it or make it anonymous.
PrivacyPage.s9Text: We may update this policy from time to time, and we will show the date of the last update at the top of this page.
PrivacyPage.s10Text: For any privacy question, or to request changing or deleting your data, contact us and we will reply as soon as possible.

AirportPage.title: إجراءات المطار <g>خطوة بخطوة</g>
AirportPage.intro: ملخص بسيط وواضح لخطوات الوصول والمغادرة، عشان تعرف إنت رايح فين وإيه المطلوب منك في كل مرحلة.
AirportPage.checkSubtitle: اضغط على كل عنصر لما تجهّزه.
AirportPage.check1Text: تأكد إنه ساري، ومدة الصلاحية المطلوبة بتختلف حسب الدولة.
AirportPage.check2Text: راجع شروط الدخول الخاصة بجنسيتك من الجهة الرسمية قبل السفر.
AirportPage.check3Text: احتفظ بنسخة على موبايلك وأخرى مطبوعة لو أمكن.
AirportPage.check4Text: حجز الفندق أو عنوان الشقة، لأنك ممكن تتسأل عنه في الجوازات.
AirportPage.check5Text: رقم الرحلة وموعد الوصول، عشان نكون في انتظارك.
AirportPage.arrivalIntro: ده الترتيب اللي هتمر بيه من لحظة نزولك من الطيارة لحد ما تركب السيارة.
AirportPage.departureIntro: ده الترتيب اللي هتمر بيه من لحظة وصولك المطار لحد ما تركب الطيارة.
AirportPage.a1Text: بعد النزول من الطيارة، اتبع لافتات «الوصول» أو «الجوازات». لو شركة الطيران وزّعت استمارة وصول، املأها بالبيانات الصحيحة وانت في الطيارة.
AirportPage.a1Tip: معاك قلم؟ ده بيوفر عليك وقت في الطابور.
AirportPage.a2Text: قدّم جواز سفرك والتأشيرة لو مطلوبة. ممكن الضابط يسألك عن سبب الزيارة ومدة الإقامة وعنوانك، فخلي بيانات الحجز في إيدك.
AirportPage.a2Tip: اتأكد إن الجواز والأوراق في مكان سهل توصله من غير ما تفتح الشنط.
AirportPage.a3Text: شوف رقم السير الخاص برحلتك على الشاشات، واستلم شنطك. لو شنطتك اتأخرت أو اتضررت، بلّغ مكتب الحقائب في المطار قبل ما تخرج.
AirportPage.a3Tip: صوّر بطاقة الحقيبة على موبايلك قبل السفر، هتفيدك لو احتجت تبلّغ.
AirportPage.a4Text: اتبع لافتات الجمارك. اعرف مسبقاً الممنوعات والمسموح بيه، وصرّح عن اللي لازم يتصرّح عنه حسب القواعد الرسمية.
AirportPage.a4Tip: احتفظ بفواتير الأجهزة الغالية اللي معاك.
AirportPage.a5Text: بعد الجمارك هتخرج لصالة الوصول. هنا تقدر تغيّر عملة أو تشتري شريحة، وخلي بالك من أي عروض تاكسي غير رسمية.
AirportPage.a5Tip: الأفضل تحجز السيارة قبل الوصول عشان تتجنب التفاوض والانتظار.
AirportPage.a6Text: هتلاقي سائقنا واقف بلافتة باسمك. ابعتلنا بيانات رحلتك على واتساب قبل الوصول، ونتابع موعد الهبوط حتى لو اتأخرت.
AirportPage.d1Text: يفضل توصل قبل ميعاد الرحلة الدولية بحوالي 3 ساعات. حدد وقت الطريق من مكانك للمطار وزوّد عليه حساب الزحمة.
AirportPage.d1Tip: تأكد من رقم الصالة (Terminal) الخاصة بشركة الطيران قبل ما تتحرك.
AirportPage.d2Text: توجّه لكاونتر شركة الطيران بالجواز والتذكرة، وسلّم شنطك واستلم كارت الصعود (Boarding Pass). تأكد إن وزن الحقائب في الحد المسموح.
AirportPage.d2Tip: وزّن شنطك في البيت، عشان ما تدفعش زيادة في المطار.
AirportPage.d3Text: قدّم جواز السفر وكارت الصعود لضابط الجوازات عشان يختم لك خروج.
AirportPage.d4Text: هتمر على جهاز التفتيش: طلّع اللابتوب والسوائل المسموحة وأي معادن من جيوبك. القواعد بتختلف قليلاً من مطار لمطار.
AirportPage.d4Tip: حط السوائل في كيس شفاف وسهل الوصول ليه.
AirportPage.d5Text: شوف رقم بوابتك على الشاشات. بعد كده تقدر تستريح أو تتسوق، بس خلي بالك إن البوابة ممكن تتغير.
AirportPage.d6Text: روح البوابة بدري وجهّز كارت الصعود والجواز. باب الطيارة بيتقفل قبل الإقلاع بوقت، فما تتأخرش.
AirportPage.tip1Text: وصولك بدري بيسيبك مرتاح من أي زحمة أو تأخير مفاجئ.
AirportPage.tip2Text: صوّر الجواز والتذكرة والحجوزات، واحفظهم في أكتر من مكان.
AirportPage.tip3Text: حط علامة مميزة على حقيبتك عشان تلاقيها بسرعة في السير.
AirportPage.tip4Text: سيارة محجوزة مسبقاً بتوفر عليك التفاوض والانتظار بعد السفر.
AirportPage.ctaText: سائقنا هيكون في انتظارك بالاسم في صالة الوصول. احجز سيارتك وضيف «استقبال من المطار»، أو كلّمنا ونرتّب لك كل حاجة.
AirportPage.ctaWaMessage: مرحباً سولو ليمو، أريد الاستفسار عن خدمة الاستقبال من المطار.
AirportPage.disclaimer: المعلومات هنا إرشادية ومبسّطة، والإجراءات والمتطلبات ممكن تتغير. تأكد دايماً من شركة الطيران والجهات الرسمية قبل سفرك.
